Best For: Landing pages, product demos, course platforms
Implementation: Use HTML5 <video> with custom controls overlay. Lazy-load poster image. Preload metadata only.
Do: Provide play/pause, volume, progress bar, fullscreen, and captions toggle
Don't: Auto-play with sound; hide controls on mobile; use Flash-based players
Accessibility Notes: Keyboard-accessible controls; visible focus rings; captions/subtitles required (WCAG 1.2.2)

Best For: Landing pages, portfolio sites, brand storytelling
Implementation: Muted autoplay loop with poster fallback. Use <video autoplay muted loop playsinline>. Compress to <5MB. Provide static image fallback for prefers-reduced-motion.
Do: Keep under 15 seconds; compress aggressively; provide poster image; respect prefers-reduced-motion
Don't: Use as primary content delivery; skip fallback image; exceed 10MB file size; include audio
Accessibility Notes: Honor prefers-reduced-motion with static fallback; ensure text overlay meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio

Implementation: Trigger modal on thumbnail click. Lazy-load iframe/player inside modal. Pause on close. Trap focus inside modal.
Do: Use thumbnail with play button overlay; pause video on modal close; trap keyboard focus
Don't: Autoplay on page load; leave video playing when modal closes; block background scroll without indication
Library Recommendation: Radix Dialog + Video.js, Headless UI, shadcn/ui Dialog
Accessibility Notes: Focus trap inside modal; Escape key closes; return focus to trigger element; aria-label on play button

Best For: Portfolio, media library, course catalog, video platforms
Implementation: Lazy-load thumbnails. Show duration badge. Use CSS Grid for responsive layout. Virtualize lists >50 items.
Do: Show duration, title, and thumbnail; lazy-load off-screen items; provide list/grid view toggle
Don't: Load all videos at once; use autoplay on hover for all items; skip pagination for large sets
Library Recommendation: Swiper, Embla Carousel, CSS Grid, TanStack Virtual
Accessibility Notes: Keyboard navigation between items; aria-label with video title; announce current position in carousel

Implementation: Use WebVTT chapters or custom chapter markers on the progress bar. Show chapter list sidebar. Highlight active chapter.
Do: Show chapter titles on progress bar; highlight current chapter; allow click-to-seek
Don't: Hide chapter navigation on mobile; use only visual markers without text labels
Library Recommendation: Video.js chapters plugin, Plyr, custom WebVTT
Accessibility Notes: Chapter markers must be keyboard-navigable; announce chapter changes to screen readers

Best For: Video platforms, search results, content browsing
Implementation: Generate thumbnail sprites. Show preview on hover with timestamp. Use CSS sprite sheets for efficiency.
Do: Show hover preview with timestamp; generate at consistent intervals; use WebP format
Don't: Use full-size frames as thumbnails; generate on client-side; skip poster for initial load
Accessibility Notes: Alt text describing video content; visible duration overlay with sufficient contrast

Keywords: adaptive, hls, dash, streaming, bitrate, quality
Best For: Live streaming, VOD platforms, video-heavy apps
Implementation: Use HLS or DASH. Provide multiple quality levels. Auto-switch based on bandwidth. Show quality selector.
Do: Provide quality selector; start with auto quality; show buffering indicator; offer bandwidth detection
Don't: Force highest quality on mobile; skip lower quality variants; ignore bandwidth changes
Accessibility Notes: Announce quality changes; provide audio-description track option; ensure controls work with screen readers

Best For: User-generated content, CMS, social platforms, course builders
Implementation: Chunked upload with progress bar. Validate format/size client-side. Show transcoding progress. Generate thumbnail on completion.
Do: Show upload progress; validate file type/size before upload; support drag-and-drop; show transcoding status
Don't: Allow unlimited file sizes; skip format validation; block UI during upload
Accessibility Notes: Announce upload progress to screen readers; provide cancel button; keyboard-accessible drop zone

Best For: Video platforms, documentation sites, learning platforms
Implementation: Use the Picture-in-Picture API. Provide a PiP toggle button. Remember user preference. Fallback to fixed mini-player.
Do: Provide explicit PiP toggle; remember user preference; show return-to-player button in PiP
Don't: Enable PiP without user action; hide the return button; break page scroll when PiP is active
Library Recommendation: Native PiP API, Video.js PiP plugin, custom implementation
Accessibility Notes: PiP button must be keyboard-accessible; announce PiP state changes; provide close/return controls

Keywords: captions, subtitles, cc, transcript, srt, vtt
Best For: All video content, accessibility compliance, multilingual apps
Implementation: Use WebVTT format. Provide caption toggle in player controls. Support multiple languages. Style captions with ::cue CSS.
Do: Enable captions by default for muted videos; support multiple languages; allow caption styling
Don't: Burn captions into video; use only auto-generated captions without review; hide caption toggle
Accessibility Notes: WCAG 1.2.2 requires captions for prerecorded audio; 1.2.4 requires live captions; user must control display

Implementation: Track play, pause, completion, seek events. Generate engagement heatmaps. Measure drop-off points.
Do: Track meaningful events (play, 25/50/75/100%); measure engagement rate; identify drop-off points
Don't: Track every frame; send analytics on every seek; store PII without consent
Library Recommendation: Mux Data, Google Analytics events, Plausible, custom event tracking
Accessibility Notes: Respect Do Not Track header; comply with GDPR consent requirements; anonymize user data

Best For: Webinars, live events, social platforms, auctions
Implementation: Use HLS for broad compatibility or WebRTC for ultra-low latency. Show live indicator badge. Provide DVR controls for rewind.
Do: Show live indicator; provide latency info; offer DVR/rewind; handle stream interruptions gracefully
Don't: Assume stable connection; skip reconnection logic; hide buffering states
Library Recommendation: hls.js, Mux, Agora, LiveKit, Amazon IVS
Accessibility Notes: Live captions required; announce stream status changes; provide text-based chat alternative

Best For: Social media tools, CMS, user-generated content platforms
Implementation: Dual-handle range slider on timeline. Show frame preview at selection points. Display selected duration.
Do: Show frame previews at trim handles; display duration of selection; provide precise time input
Don't: Process trimming client-side for large files; skip preview of trim result; use imprecise controls
Accessibility Notes: Keyboard-operable trim handles; announce selected range; visible focus on active handle

Best For: Virtual tours, real estate, travel, interactive experiences
Implementation: Use WebXR or Three.js for rendering. Provide mouse/touch drag navigation. Support gyroscope on mobile. Offer flat fallback.
Do: Provide mouse/touch/gyroscope controls; show navigation hints; offer 2D fallback view
Don't: Require VR headset; skip mobile gyroscope support; auto-start in VR mode
Library Recommendation: Three.js, A-Frame, Google VR View, Video.js VR plugin
Accessibility Notes: Provide 2D fallback; keyboard navigation for viewpoint; describe scene in alt text; motion sickness warning

Best For: Social video platforms, educational content, live events
Implementation: Allow emoji reactions or comments pinned to specific timestamps. Show reaction density on timeline. Moderate content.
Do: Pin reactions to timestamps; show density visualization on timeline; moderate user content
Don't: Allow unmoderated content; show all reactions simultaneously; skip spam filtering
Library Recommendation: Custom implementation, WebSocket for real-time, Firebase
Accessibility Notes: Announce new reactions to screen readers optionally; keyboard-accessible reaction picker; filter controls
